name: pal-street
js: (() => { const b=document.getElementById("btn-toggle-hud"); if(b && !document.body.classList.contains("film")){b.click();document.body.classList.add("film");} })();(() => { const app = window.__CITY_APP; app.teleportTo(-1948, -1600, 0); app.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [-1948, 1.7, -1600], look: [-1948, 4, -1500], fov: 66 }); console.log('[ride-check] roofs ' + JSON.stringify(window.CITY.roofStats || null)); })();(() => { setTimeout(() => { console.log('[ride-check] census ' + JSON.stringify((() => { const app = window.__CITY_APP; const names = {}; let total = 0; app.scene.traverse((o) => { if (o.isMesh && o.geometry && /Roofs/.test(o.name)) { const g = o.geometry; const t = (g.index ? g.index.count : g.attributes.position.count) / 3; names[o.name] = (names[o.name] || 0) + t; total += t; } }); const i = app.renderer.info.render; return { roofTriangles: total, names, frameTriangles: i.triangles, drawCalls: i.drawCalls ?? i.calls }; })())); }, 6000); })()
